title: Shape the LinkGuard install page
question: Three ways to lay out the GitHub Pages site, all in the Return to Sender look. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Questions first
options.thesis: The page answers what a nervous person actually asks, and the install steps are one of the answers.
options.viewport: Headline 'Is this link safe?' answered by a stamped example link; to the right, a ruled list of questions with 'How do I install it?' open and its Download button live.
options.risk: If the questions read as an FAQ dump, the install action gets lost; it has to stay the open answer.

options.label: Install first
options.thesis: Someone you sent here came to install it: the download and three steps own the first screen.
options.viewport: Kraft field with the browser picked automatically, a big Download button and three illustrated steps; the stamp specimen sits beside them as the one line of 'what it does'.
options.risk: Explains least; works best when the person already trusts whoever sent them the link.

options.label: Before / after
options.thesis: Show the trick: a scam email's link, and the same link stamped NOT SAFE with the reasons.
options.viewport: A labelled example scam email fills the hero, its PayPal link stamped NOT SAFE with the ticked slip beside it; headline and Download button above.
options.risk: The example email must read clearly as an example, never as a real message.
